title: Does sharpness-based first-anchor + single-wind proximity/variation second-anchor + |ω|-clamp invert the slow-tumbler class generally?

last_measured.summary: BLOCKED: the s111 decimation fix is correct (fixed-2° preserves resolution) but the fixed-2° A×B cross is intractable on weak-anchor seeds (116 B=ep52 → 40941 cells → 211M pairs; coarse-6° → 16.4M). The anchor-cap forces a close-and-weak B; the s111 adaptive coarsening was load-bearing for tractability. Needs a weak-anchor-aware cross redesign (C-anchor pre-prune / Basin characterisation).
